say:1:1530139401:0.text: Because we studied it, of course!
say:1:1530139401:0.source_cn: 当然是因为，我们研究过！
say:1:1530139401:0.male: Because we studied it, of course!
say:1:1530139401:0.female: Because we studied it, of course!

say:2:1530139402:0.text: Every record shows the goddess's arrival is random!
say:2:1530139402:0.source_cn: 所有有记载的降临，表明这本就是没有规律的！
say:2:1530139402:0.male: Every record shows the goddess's arrival is random!
say:2:1530139402:0.female: Every record shows the goddess's arrival is random!

say:3:1530139403:0.text: Wake up, Watcat. Stop chasing after signs of the divine!
say:3:1530139403:0.source_cn: 醒醒吧，水猫，不要再想着研究神降了！
